scope: Quantum topology, effective torsional operators and advanced kinematics within the constrained-conformer branch
case_selection: reuse both first archived biological case conformers and the same first two bridge axes; no new outcome selection

kinematics.connection: A_i=I^-1 ell_i in the chosen body section; Rdot=R hat(-A_i qdot_i)
kinematics.curvature_convention: F_12=partial_1 A_2-partial_2 A_1-A_1 cross A_2; log R_loop=-F_12 area+o(area)
kinematics.integrator: DOP853, rtol1e-11 atol1e-13; orthogonality and angular momentum residual retained

quantum.coefficient_model: periodic bilinear interpolation separately of rho=sqrt(det g), A=rho g^-1, W=rho E; exact Fourier integrals via DFT times tensor sinc-squared factors
quantum.operator: closed quadratic form kappa integral grad(u)* A grad(u)+integral W |u|^2 on weighted L2(rho dq)
quantum.kappa: hbar^2/(2 atomic_mass_unit Angstrom^2), converted to kcal/mol with Avogadro constant
quantum.thermal_output: finite Fourier model only; all generalized eigenvalues included, density evaluation discards only total normalized spectral weight<=1e-12
quantum.basis_scope: fixed-grid nested variational approximations; grid sensitivity is separate and no ab initio accuracy claim

knots.exact_fixture: Temperley-Lieb closure of two-strand braids sigma_1^m with odd m from -9 through9, plus generator/inverse identities; formal A, delta=-A^2-A^-2, writhe correction (-A^3)^-w, t=A^-4
knots.coordinates: first model C-alpha trace, unique residues, highest occupancy altloc with deterministic tie break; reject missing internal residues or consecutive CA distance outside2.5to4.5 Angstrom
knots.closure: 64 deterministic Fibonacci sphere directions, farpoint at centroid+100*max_radius*direction; polygon closes C terminus to farpoint to N terminus
knots.projection: one fixed generic proper rotation per closure based on seed29102026, retry up to4 if numerical nongenericity
knots.invariant: exact integer Fox colouring cofactor determinant abs(Delta(-1)); this is not a complete knot classifier and does not distinguish mirrors
knots.mirror_check: repeat with x reflection and transformed projection so crossing signs reverse without changing determinant
knots.claim_boundary: closure-dependent diagnostics for open protein chains, not intrinsic open-chain topology or a function prediction

primary_boundaries: Jones chirality signal is sufficient when nonzero but not complete
mirror-even quantum spectra cannot determine handedness
geometric reconstruction under prescribed shape motion is not a simulated free molecular trajectory
fixed Fourier variational monotonicity does not prove grid or physical convergence
